featured_title: Breckenridge Golf & Tennis Club Estero FL: Which Village Should You Buy In? 2026
featured_excerpt: Breckenridge in Estero bundles an 18-hole par-3 course into a master assessment of about $2,600 to $2,800 a year, but total fees run $7,780 to $13,000 depending on which village you buy in — because they track building height, not price.
